name: Elasticsearch VDB Provider
description: Provides an Elasticsearch backend for the AI Search module using native dense_vector mappings and HNSW algorithms.

suggests.drupal/search_api_attachments: Required only if you want to use the bundled pure-PHP PDF text extractor (php_pdfparser_extractor).

project_description: An Elasticsearch backend for the Drupal AI module and its AI Search submodule. Stores and retrieves embeddings using Elasticsearch's native dense_vector field with HNSW-accelerated approximate kNN, so semantic search and RAG run directly against your existing Elastic Stack with no separate vector database to operate. It registers the VDB provider plugin 'elasticsearch' (label "Elasticsearch (Native kNN)") and uniquely supports hybrid search (kNN + BM25 merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion) in a single Elasticsearch request on ES 8.8+. Credentials (an API key, or Basic Auth password) are held in Key module entities; the cluster host, index prefix and similarity metric are set on the provider settings form. It also ships an optional pure-PHP PDF text extractor plugin for Search API Attachments and an event subscriber that registers extra text/document MIME types for indexing. Experimental module in the AI Vector Database Providers package.
